name: Mobile Application Security
description: Mobile Application Security standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-MOB-SEC applies.

rules.title: Store credentials and sensitive keys in platform secure storage
rules.detail: Use Keychain/Keystore-backed facilities for secrets; ordinary preferences/shared storage are not acceptable for long-lived credentials.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Store credentials and sensitive keys in platform secure storage.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Store credentials and sensitive keys in platform secure storage.

rules.title: Treat rooted or jailbroken devices as increased risk, not a complete control boundary
rules.detail: Detect when appropriate and adjust risk/telemetry, but do not rely on root detection as the sole protection for secrets or authorization.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Treat rooted or jailbroken devices as increased risk, not a complete control boundary.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Treat rooted or jailbroken devices as increased risk, not a complete control boundary.

rules.title: Validate deep links and app links before navigation
rules.detail: Allow only expected schemes/hosts/routes and re-check authentication/authorization before opening protected destinations.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Validate deep links and app links before navigation.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Validate deep links and app links before navigation.

rules.title: Protect network communication
rules.detail: Use TLS with platform validation; certificate pinning is applied only with a rotation/recovery plan and must not disable normal certificate verification.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Protect network communication.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Protect network communication.

rules.title: Prevent sensitive leakage through screenshots, clipboard and logs where required
rules.detail: Classify sensitive screens/data and apply screenshot/clipboard/logging restrictions proportionate to risk and platform capability.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Prevent sensitive leakage through screenshots, clipboard and logs where required.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Prevent sensitive leakage through screenshots, clipboard and logs where required.

rules.title: Use biometrics only as local user-presence verification
rules.detail: Biometrics may unlock a protected credential or sensitive action but do not replace server-side authentication/authorization.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use biometrics only as local user-presence verification.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use biometrics only as local user-presence verification.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-MOB-SEC applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Mobile Application Security to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Mobile Application Security is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Mobile Application Security failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
